title: Seasons of Glass and Iron
description: Full of glimpses into gleaming worlds and fairy tales with teeth, Seasons of Glass and Iron: Stories is a collection of acclaimed and awarded work from Amal El-Mohtar.A stunning performance. - Kirkus on The River Has Roots (Earphones Award winner)With confidence and style, El-Mohtar guides us through exquisitely told and sharply observed tales about life as it is, was, and could be.
